title: Segfault with SessionLoadPost au that wipes buffers

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
- `nvim --version`:
 NVIM v0.2.0-842-gec4e84210
Build type: RelWithDebInfo

- Vim (version: ) behaves differently? Same crash, but outputs this message before crashing:
```
Vim: Caught deadly signal SEGV

Vim: Finished.
```
- Operating system/version: Linux 4.10.1-1-ARCH 
- Terminal name/version: Using Terminator 1.91 with fish shell
- `$TERM`: xterm-256color

### Actual behaviour
Segfaults

### Expected behaviour
Not segfaulting

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

```
nvim -u NORC hello
:w
:tabnew
:mksession
:qa
```
then using this init.vim:
```
set shada=
set noswapfile

function! DeleteInactiveBufs()
  exe 'tabfirst'
  let tabblist = []
  for i in range(1, tabpagenr('$'))
    " get errors when I have + 1 like docs show
    call extend(tabblist, tabpagebuflist(i))
  endfor

  for b in range(1, bufnr('$'))
    if bufexists(b) && buflisted(b) && (index(tabblist, b) == -1 || bufname(b) =~# '^$')
      exec 'bwipeout ' . b
    endif
  endfor
endfunction

au SessionLoadPost * call DeleteInactiveBufs()
```
run this:
```
nvim -u init.vim -S Session.vim --noplugin
```
The setting of no shada, noswapfile, and running with --noplugin aren't necessary to reproduce the crash.
